title: add basic hero slider
description:
For definition, please have a look into idea ticket. Also you have to read the additional informations provided by Caro [in the design](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4633-61147&m=dev).

Storybook stories have been created:

* Only a single slide
* Multiple slides:

    * The first with a dark background image
    * The second with a light background image
    
* One with a CTA-slide in the first slide
* One with two CTAs in the first slide
* One with a single flag in the first slide
* One with multiple flags in the first slide
* Some more examples you may think of

Playgrounds can be found here:

* <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=1219-51525&p=f&m=dev&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=4633%3A65467&show-proto-sidebar=1</custom> (mobile)
* <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-1">https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=1219-51525&p=f&m=dev&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=4734%3A30227&show-proto-sidebar=1</custom> (desktop)

## Technical details

These are not exhaustive lists of all props. Please have a look at the ideas-page and the design to figure out additional props you may have to define for each component.

### Block/BasicHeroSliderBlock/BasicHeroSliderSlide.vue

Some props:

* background fallback color
* background media:

    * mobile
    * desktop
    * (ignore videos for now)
    
* background color dark/light
* heading
* subline
* content alignment mobile/desktop
* flags

    * style
    * background
    
* CTAs
* Overlay

    * Gradient/Full color
    * Opacity
    

If possible, try using the `container` class for slide maxwidth.

### Block/BasicHeroSliderBlock/BasicHeroSliderBlock.vue

For slider you can use Swiper. Nuxt Swiper @1.2.2 (using the Swiperjs Vue API) is already installed and can be used.

* [Nuxt Swiper](https://github.com/cpreston321/nuxt-swiper/tree/v1.2.2) docs
* [Swiper.js Vue](https://swiperjs.com/vue) docs
* [Related PR](https://github.com/laioutr/laioutr/pull/75)

Some props:

* slides: an array of props for BasicHeroSliderSlide

Use SwiperNavigationCompact for navigation. Wait for <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-2">https://laioutr.atlassian.net/browse/THEMES-19</custom>. You probably need to make some kind of modification to the component for it to adapt to the background being either dark or light.

summary: A flexible hero component serving as static hero section or interactive slider with full-width backgrounds.
features: Separate mobile and desktop image uploads for responsive design
Dark and light background modes with automatic text color adjustment
Up to two customizable CTA buttons per slide
Gradient or full-color overlay with adjustable opacity
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Basic Hero Slider provides website owners with a versatile hero component that serves dual purposes: a static hero section for focused messaging and an interactive slider for showcasing multiple promotional items. This flexibility enables engaging landing pages and prominent content displays.

## Use Cases

- **Landing page heroes**: Display full-width promotional banners with compelling imagery and call-to-action buttons
- **Product launches**: Showcase new arrivals or featured products with dedicated slides
- **Campaign promotion**: Rotate through multiple marketing messages with automatic or manual navigation
- **Brand storytelling**: Present brand narratives with combined imagery, headings, and sublines

## Design Rationale

The component prioritizes responsive design with separate mobile and desktop image configurations, ensuring optimal visual presentation across devices. The dark/light mode detection enables automatic text color adjustment for readability. Overlay options with adjustable opacity provide design flexibility while maintaining content legibility.
